# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

[ Explore the portfolio ][65]
[Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch representing adhesives and coatings
solutions for flexible materials.] Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch
representing adhesives and coatings solutions for flexible materials.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

[ Discover the innovation ][66]
[A person holding an open plastic food container filled with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a
glowing edge highlighting the packaging.] A person holding an open plastic food container filled
with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.

# Empowering **local communities** to create lasting impact

Bostik proudly launches its Community Grant Programme to empower impactful local initiatives around
the world. By supporting community organizations and local partners, the programme helps bring
sustainable, meaningful projects to life, strengthening connections, fostering collaboration, and
creating lasting positive change where it matters most.

[ Discover the programme ][67]
[A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.]
A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.

# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

[ Explore the portfolio ][65]
[Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch representing adhesives and coatings
solutions for flexible materials.] Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch
representing adhesives and coatings solutions for flexible materials.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

[ Discover the innovation ][66]
[A person holding an open plastic food container filled with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a
glowing edge highlighting the packaging.] A person holding an open plastic food container filled
with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.

# Empowering **local communities** to create lasting impact

Bostik proudly launches its Community Grant Programme to empower impactful local initiatives around
the world. By supporting community organizations and local partners, the programme helps bring
sustainable, meaningful projects to life, strengthening connections, fostering collaboration, and
creating lasting positive change where it matters most.

[ Discover the programme ][67]
[A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.]
A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.

# Discover ITW

A global industrial company built around a differentiated business model.

[Angled Line Graphic]
+ ITW Business Model
[

The ITW Business Model is our company's defining competitive advantage.

>][29]
+ Business Segments
[

ITW's seven industry-leading segments leverage the ITW Business Model to generate solid growth with
best-in-class margins and returns.

>][30]
+ Enterprise Strategy
[

Our long-term enterprise strategy is focused on leveraging the performance power of the ITW Business
Model.

>][31]

*Founded in 1912, ITW is a global multi-industry manufacturing leader built around a differentiated
and proprietary business model. The company's seven industry-leading segments leverage the ITW
Business Model to generate solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns.*

*ITW has never been stronger or better positioned for the future. We are committed to executing our
enterprise strategy to deliver differentiated performance over the long term and firmly establishing
ITW as one of the best performing, highest-quality and most respected industrial companies.*

# Manufacturer, Formulator, and Innovator of Adhesives

Permabond manufactures many types of industrial adhesive products to suit the varied needs of a
number of different industries.

[ Contact Us ][209]

## View our Corporate Video

## Providing Adhesive Solutions Worldwide

##### Adhesives For All Industries

With offices located around the world, Permabond provides expert technical help, product
recommendations, samples, laboratory testing, or even the development of custom formulations for all
industries. We offer short lead times and low minimum order quantities, even for custom
formulations.

##### Highest Quality Products

Permabond supplies consistent high-quality industrial adhesive products to ensure customer
production lines run quickly and smoothly. Contact us for a free production line audit or assistance
with introducing industrial adhesive materials into fully automated or manual production lines.

##### Helping To Provide Solutions

Our sales and technical experts are supported by a worldwide network of distributors to assist you
with all of your bonding and sealing needs. For information on product pack sizes, adhesive
availability, and contact details of local distributors, please contact Permabond in your region.

# Manufacturer, Formulator, and Innovator of Adhesives

Permabond manufactures many types of industrial adhesive products to suit the varied needs of a
number of different industries.

[ Contact Us ][209]

## View our Corporate Video

## Providing Adhesive Solutions Worldwide

##### Adhesives For All Industries

With offices located around the world, Permabond provides expert technical help, product
recommendations, samples, laboratory testing, or even the development of custom formulations for all
industries. We offer short lead times and low minimum order quantities, even for custom
formulations.

##### Highest Quality Products

Permabond supplies consistent high-quality industrial adhesive products to ensure customer
production lines run quickly and smoothly. Contact us for a free production line audit or assistance
with introducing industrial adhesive materials into fully automated or manual production lines.

##### Helping To Provide Solutions

Our sales and technical experts are supported by a worldwide network of distributors to assist you
with all of your bonding and sealing needs. For information on product pack sizes, adhesive
availability, and contact details of local distributors, please contact Permabond in your region.

building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Adhesives are materials that join two surfaces together, typically by creating a bond. The use of
adhesives dates back to prehistoric times when early humans used natural adhesives like tree resin
and animal hide glue to make tools and weapons. Over time, adhesives became more sophisticated, and
new materials and formulations were developed. For example, the ancient Egyptians used animal glue
and beeswax to bind papyrus scrolls, while the Romans used a mixture of lime and volcanic ash to
make cement. [Read More…][49]

Adhesives The term “adhesives” applies to a wide variety of substances that, when applied, binds one
or more flat surfaces together. Types of binding that adhesives provide include sealing, bonding,
and laminating, both permanent and temporary. Adhesives can also waterproof and level surfaces, trap
liquids, and fill holes and seams. Adhesives are made through the combination of an epoxy resin and
a hardening substance, called a curing mechanism.

products, and other demanding manufacturing environments. Industrial adhesive suppliers offering
epoxy formulations often support applications that require gap filling, long-term performance, and
strong bonds across metals, composites, and other engineered materials.

### Fast-Bonding Adhesives and Production Efficiency

Cyanoacrylate adhesives, pressure-sensitive products, and other fast-bonding formulations support
quick assembly and clean application across many production settings. These adhesives and glues are
often used in electronics, medical device manufacturing, woodworking, repair operations, labeling,
and consumer product assembly. Buyers researching industrial adhesive glue options in this category
often look for curing speed, substrate compatibility, and process efficiency when comparing adhesive
suppliers.

### Flexible and High-Performance Adhesive Types

Polyurethane, acrylic, silicone, and hot melt adhesives serve buyers who need flexibility, weather
resistance, impact resistance, sealing performance, or rapid line speeds. These product types are
frequently sourced for construction materials, packaging lines, furniture production, automotive
glass installation, signage, textiles, filtration products, and general industrial assembly. For
procurement teams evaluating industrial strength adhesive or industrial strength glue solutions,
these categories are often central to balancing performance, throughput, and application conditions.

Automotive manufacturers rely on adhesive suppliers for panel bonding, trim attachment, glass

producers need precision adhesive products for component mounting, sensor bonding, and assemblies

insulation, roofing, and sealing applications that must handle movement and moisture exposure.
Packaging operations depend on fast-setting products that keep high-speed lines moving efficiently.
Medical, energy, marine, and woodworking markets also require specialized adhesive manufacturers
that understand bonding performance, environmental exposure, and material compatibility.

high-speed dispensing and fast set times for automated lines, while others prioritize bond strength,
cure control, or extended working time for more complex assemblies. Buyers comparing industrial
adhesive suppliers should match the adhesive type to both throughput goals and process demands.

improve consistency, and support smoother implementation.

application, buyers may need documentation tied to quality systems, material standards,
environmental requirements, or product-specific performance testing. Reviewing these requirements
early helps narrow the directory to suppliers that already support regulated or specification-driven
manufacturing.

manufacturers focus on packaging and converting, while others support transportation, electronics,
medical production, or construction materials. Buyers should compare technical support, formulation
range, application knowledge, and experience with similar production challenges before choosing an
adhesive supplier.

need, often tied to durability, structural loads, harsh environments, or long service life. Buyers
should review the actual use case rather than rely on the label alone.

operations need more than a strong bond; they need materials that work cleanly within existing line
speeds and quality targets. It also helps to compare technical support and the supplier’s experience
